data.location: 1151 W Pacific Coast Hwy, Harbor City, CA 90710
data.status: planning a restaurant; opening timeline has not been publicly announced
data.short_description: Public filings show Tokyo Sushi is planning a restaurant at 1151 W. Pacific Coast Highway in Harbor City, expanding a concept that operates in Simi Valley. The project lists seating for 137 guests indoors and may qualify to serve beer and wine. The operator is E2 USA Inc.

data.location: 100 N Kirk Rd, St. Charles, IL 60174
data.status: construction at a busy corner; looking at an opening date in Q1 of 2027
data.short_description: Parker Hospitality is bringing Match Haus, a sports, food and cocktail concept, to 100 N Kirk Road in St. Charles. The three-story building will have six pickleball courts, duckpin bowling, three padel courts, a social kitchen and a cafe. The founder said the team is targeting a Q1 2027 opening.

The Blazin' Burgerz team is opening a new concept, Blazin' Smash Haus, at 3354 Washtenaw Avenue in Ann Arbor. It is the second location from Farook Issa and will add items like a mozzarella burger and jalapeno smash burgers. The first location opened in January 2021 in Ypsilanti.

data.status: site plan approved; isn't under construction yet
data.short_description: Elgin council approved a site plan for a 7 Brew at 1039-1047 Summit Street. An opening date has not been set because the project isn't under construction yet. Franchisee Who Brew has previously opened several Chicago-area locations.

data.location: 203 Fulton Street, Seaport neighborhood, New York City
data.status: opening its new bakery on November 9
data.short_description: Sadie's is opening a new bakery in New York City's Seaport neighborhood on November 9, next door to the existing Sadie's restaurant. The bakery will offer house-made breads, pastries, cakes, cookies and coffee. It will open daily at 7 a.m.

Southern Italian restaurant Oenotri announced on social media that it will permanently close at 1425 First Street on Saturday, November 14. The restaurant opened in 2010. Regular customers expressed disappointment about the closure.

data.status: opening its third Georgia location on November 6
data.short_description: StillFire Brewing is opening its third Georgia location at 2316 Main Street in downtown Tucker on November 6. It occupies a space previously home to High Card Brewing and Blue Tarp Brewing and will feature 18 draft taps. A three-day grand opening event is planned.

data.status: permanent closure; served its final meal on October 30
data.short_description: Pho Binh permanently closed its Katy location on Nelson Way after serving its final meal on October 30, ending a five-year run. The restaurant had operated irregularly after a fire in September injured its chef. Four other Pho Binh locations remain in the Houston area.

Salted Melon, a health-focused restaurant and neighborhood market, is opening its second Metro Atlanta location in Sandy Springs. It is expected to open in summer 2027. The menu will include salads, bowls, smoothies and pastries.

data.status: expected to open along with the development in 2027
data.short_description: Chastain Creamery will open a location at Hillcrest in Sandy Springs, its second Atlanta-area location. The store is expected to open with the development in 2027. It is known for more than 50 handcrafted, small-batch ice cream flavors.

data.location: 6079 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy Fl 347, Kissimmee, FL 34747
data.short_description: The Flying Biscuit Café opened its first Orlando-market café in Kissimmee on October 26, 2026. It is owned by franchise partners John and Gisela Terranova and seats 108. It serves breakfast and lunch daily from 7 a.m. to 3 p.m.

data.location: 833 East Las Olas Boulevard, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33301
data.short_description: Caviar Club by Falsetto Hospitality opened to the public on October 21, 2026, on Las Olas Boulevard in downtown Fort Lauderdale. The American steakhouse and late-night destination does not require a membership to dine. It includes a 40-seat Bar Room and a Dining Room.

Owner and chef Adam Campbell announced on Instagram that the Shaw sandwich shop Dragon Hero will close permanently on November 5. The shop is known for 12-inch subs named after mythical heroes. Customers expressed disappointment on social media.

Ultimate Longevity Center is preparing to open at 5500 Canoga Ave. in the Calabasas-Woodland Hills area, listed as "Coming Soon" on its website. The wellness concept is backed by Gary Brecka and combines health assessments, recovery services and retail products.

data.location: The Forum Carlsbad, 1905 Calle Barcelona, Suite 210
data.status: plans to open in January 2027; Coming Soon
data.short_description: The article references Ultimate Longevity Center's plans to open at The Forum Carlsbad in January 2027. That center is also listed as "Coming Soon."

data.location: 1515 N Town E Blvd, Mesquite, TX 75150
data.short_description: Public filings show Five Below is planning a new store at 1515 N. Town East Blvd. in Mesquite. The filings list a construction completion date of October 2027, which may not reflect the actual opening timeline. It would be the retailer's third Mesquite location.

data.location: 122 Vintage Park Blvd. Suite G, Houston, TX 77070
data.status: Grand opening celebrations took place on October 24
data.short_description: JETSET Pilates opened a new studio in Houston's Vintage Park area, owned by Eric and Jessica Denton. The studio hosted preview classes from October 19–30. Its grand opening celebration was held on October 24.

data.status: optimistic about being ready in the first half of 2027
data.short_description: Steve Salis will open a new steakhouse called Woodruffs at the former Cava Mezze space on Barracks Row instead of a Federalist Pig. A specific opening date has not been set. Leadership hopes to open in the first half of 2027.

data.status: Construction has been underway; unclear when 1833 Tavern will open
data.short_description: Chef David Bartlett is bringing 1833 Tavern to Mercer Village in the former Mercer Village Pizza space. Construction was underway throughout October. Macon Supper Club will operate within the tavern.

data.status: will open; opening date has not been announced
data.short_description: Down South Flavor, run by Bobby Pressley Jr. and Christy Pressley, will open at 13 Church Street in Grantville. The restaurant serves Southern comfort food. No opening date has been announced.
The article states that Down South Flavor recently shuttered in Whitesburg before its move to Grantville.

data.event_date: by the end of the year
data.status: slated to open by the end of the year
data.short_description: Wagaya Groceries will open its third location at Emory Village, two doors down from the Wagaya restaurant. It will include a Japanese and East Asian grocery store and a sit-down tonkatsu cafe. The owner said it is slated to open by the end of the year.

data.status: will open at Inman Quarter in 2027
data.short_description: The article states that a Wagaya Groceries location will open at Inman Quarter in 2027. The Emory Village store will be about twice as large as this location.

Chef Leonard Yu, behind Omakase Table and Ryokou, will open Nori Yu Handroll Bar this fall. The 12-seat space will feature a wood bar and focus on fresh hand rolls. Construction updates were posted throughout October.

data.status: will be opening a new location in Locust Point next year
data.short_description: Wonder will open a Locust Point location in the storefront that previously housed PNC Bank. The concept prioritizes take-out and delivery but will have limited seating. The company website states it will open in February of next year.

data.location: Lot 810, Dulles Boulevard side of the planned Shops at Arcola, Loudoun County
data.footage_size: 5,704 square foot storefront (within the planned 102,843 square foot Shops at Arcola)
data.short_description: Firebirds has signed on to open at the planned Shops at Arcola development. Construction on the retail center has not begun and no opening timeline has been projected. Other signed tenants include Shake Shack and Tifa Chocolate & Gelato.

data.location: 265 N Lamar Boulevard, Ste Y, Oxford, MS 38655
data.short_description: Bar Nero, an Italian-inspired aperitivo bar from the team behind the shuttered Bar Muse, will open in the former home of Growler. It will share the space with Mea Culpa and is led by Joe Stinchcomb and Ross Hester. No opening date has been announced.

data.location: 265 N Lamar Boulevard, Ste Y, Oxford, MS 38655
data.status: plans to open before the year's end
data.short_description: Mea Culpa, from Joe Stinchcomb, Ross Hester, and Marco D'Emidio, will serve pizza and focaccia sandwiches in the former Growler space. It is described as a fast casual lunch spot with cocktails and wines on tap and grab & go options. An opening date is not available, but it is projected to open this fall.

data.status: currently expanding to add indoor dining
data.short_description: Da' Pearl Seafood & PoBoys is expanding to add indoor dining after acquiring surrounding property with 270 feet of commercial frontage along Highway 41. The outdoor patio closed on October 25 for construction, and a temporary tent is serving guests. A launch date for the indoor dining room has not been set.

Simply Done Catering and Events will open a storefront called Simply Done Main Street Market in Collierville Town Square. It will offer take and bake meals, bread, eggs, grab and go sandwiches, salads, and more. No opening date has been announced.

data.store_name: Unnamed Banh Mi Boys sister restaurant
data.short_description: Banh Mi Boys founder Peter Nguyen has taken over the former PrimoHoagies location for a new sister restaurant. It will be a fast-casual concept with Asian and Southern food influences, separate from Banh Mi Boys. The name will be revealed once the sign goes up.

data.location: 2272 First St., Unit 101, Fort Myers, FL 33901
data.short_description: Plan review documents submitted by CSC of Downtown LLC show a new Cold Stone Creamery will open in downtown Fort Myers. It will join a First Street restaurant community including Izzy's Fish & Oyster, Sip & Sizzle, and Scoops on First.

data.status: preparing to take over the space
data.short_description: Deanna's Wine Bar will share the former 7-Eleven space in West Ashley with Bert's Pig Shop. The project is led by Bert Sheffield and Douglas Hickerson, and the bar will feature wines from small European and domestic makers.

data.status: preparing to take over the space
data.short_description: Bert's Pig Shop will be a "pig-to-table" charcuterie spot sharing the space with Deanna's Wine Bar. It will use fresh meats from Peculiar Pig, a family farm in Dorchester, with charcuterie made on-site.

data.location: 1230 Austin Hwy, Alamo Hills Shopping Center, San Antonio
data.event_date: Not before the second quarter of 2027
data.status: signed on to the shopping center
data.short_description: Chicken Salad Chick has signed on to Alamo Hills Shopping Center near Alamo Heights, per Foresite Commercial Real Estate. An opening date has not been announced, but it is not expected to open before the second quarter of 2027.

Hachiya Ramen is opening a Clements Ferry location. The opening originally expected for November 2 was postponed pending final approval of its Certificate of Occupancy. No new opening date has been revealed.

data.store_name: Dark Side Brick Oven Pizza Co.
data.short_description: Owner Michael Hawes plans to open the concept's first San Antonio location, an express location in a new strip mall, by March 2027. The space will feature 1980s collectibles from the original Boerne restaurant. The exact address has not been disclosed.
The Palmetto Cafe at The Charleston Place will close at the end of this year as BHC reimagines the hotel's restaurant roster. Replacement concepts are expected to debut in 2028.
The Thoroughbred Club at The Charleston Place will close at the end of this year. A new lobby bar paying homage to it is planned among the replacement concepts.

data.store_name: Daniel Humm pop-up (former Charleston Grill space)
data.short_description: Chef Daniel Humm's pop-up in the former home of the Charleston Grill has finished its run. The space is part of the hotel's restaurant reimagining.
A new signature restaurant is planned at The Charleston Place, with dishes finished tableside. It is expected to debut in 2028.
A pub-inspired spot for casual dining is among the replacement concepts at The Charleston Place. It is expected to debut in 2028.
A new lobby bar paying homage to the Thoroughbred Club is planned at The Charleston Place. It is expected to debut in 2028.

A smoke shop registered as HookHer LLC, attached to a tax office, has submitted a zoning letter for 2535 Broad Avenue. It will offer tobacco products, hookah, coffee, and muffins, with Wi-Fi and printing services. The applicant is Alisha Park.

Knead Hospitality & Design is exploring a luxury wellness retreat on the 47 acre property where The Briar Patch Bed and Breakfast Inn still operates. Plans call for 20 guest suites, 3 wellness buildings, and a pool and spa facility. If all goes to plan, it could open in 2028.
As8 Market LLC has a certificate of occupancy under review as of October 30 for a convenience store with gas pumps. The application indicates the concept will span 3,500 square feet.
J. Crew Factory will open at Midlothian Depot between Dave's Hot Chicken and My Eye Dr. The website describes it as "coming soon," and the full project is slated for completion in 2027.
Abercrombie & Fitch is under construction at Annapolis Mall across from Victoria's Secret. It aims to open before November is over, in time for Black Friday.

Ambition Fitness, a women-focused fitness concept, is preparing its first Cincinnati location at The Ridge in Pleasant Ridge. It signed a 10-year lease in October and plans to hire about 15 employees. An exact opening date has not been announced.

data.location: 15701 San Pedro Ave., San Antonio, TX 78232
data.status: preparing to open a new salon location
data.short_description: Studio 27 Hair Salon is opening a new location in a different space within Country Village Plaza, per a TDLR filing. The approximately $350,000 project begins November 2, 2026 and is expected to be completed by January 15, 2027. Co-founder Roger Woodard confirmed it is a new location, not a renovation of the existing space.
